title: Turtle holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e63950'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81f38'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shellGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8ee06a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#4caf3a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e7d24'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 40 C48 55 44 62 40 70' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='27' rx='15' ry='17' fill='url(#balloonGrad)'/>
  <path d='M48 43 L52 47 L56 43 Z' fill='#c22a44'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='21' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffd7de' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- turtle legs -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='86' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6a9e4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6a9e4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5a8a3e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5a8a3e'/>

  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='73' rx='26' ry='19' fill='url(#shellGrad)'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <path d='M42 56 L52 66 L46 80 L38 80 L32 66 Z' fill='#a6e88a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M62 68 L68 77 L58 82 Z' fill='#a6e88a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M22 68 L16 77 L26 82 Z' fill='#a6e88a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='73' rx='26' ry='19' fill='none' stroke='#b6f29c' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='68' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#7bc456'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='68' rx='12' ry='11' fill='none' stroke='#a3e07e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='65' r='2.8' fill='#1c3d10'/>
  <circle cx='74.9' cy='64.1' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M68 72 Q71 75 75 73' stroke='#2e5a1c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- arm reaching up to string -->
  <path d='M66 78 Q60 74 55 68' stroke='#7bc456' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
